title: Critical Angle Answer
description: Essential Criteria - The correct critical angle for total internal reflection in water must be identified as 50 degrees.

title: Energy Flux Answer
description: Essential Criteria - The correct energy flux of sunlight at Earth's orbit must be identified as 10^{-1} watt/cm².

title: Electron Flow Answer
description: Essential Criteria - The correct number of electrons flowing through the filament must be identified as 10^{19} s^{-1}.

title: Critical Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The calculation of the critical angle using the refractive index of water must be shown.

title: Energy Flux Calculation
description: Important Criteria - The reasoning for the energy flux value must include understanding of solar energy distribution.

title: Electron Calculation Method
description: Important Criteria - The method for calculating the number of electrons per second must reference the relationship between current and charge.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - Units must be consistent and correctly applied throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common sign mistakes in calculations or misinterpretation of values must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Missing factors in the calculations, such as the charge of an electron, must be checked.
